hero.title: Asiacuisine.re
hero.subtitle: From Guangzhou to Réunion Island — an experienced private chef brings you the authentic taste of Asia, right in the comfort of your home.

services.cover_text: A journey of flavors and culture — discover my signature services.
services.service1_desc: Enjoy a fine-dining experience without leaving your home.
services.service1_feature1: Tailor-made menus to suit your taste
services.service2_desc: Learn authentic techniques from a chef who lived in China for over 10 years.
services.service2_feature3: Discover unique ingredients and their stories
services.service3_desc: Authentic Asian flavors, freshly prepared and ready to enjoy.
services.service3_feature1: A variety of Asian cuisines to choose from
services.page4_desc: For special requests or to discuss your next culinary event.

about.p1: I lived in Guangzhou, China, for ten years, fully immersing myself in authentic Chinese culinary culture.
about.p2: During that time, I worked alongside chefs from across Asia, broadening my skills and appreciation of diverse flavors.
about.p3: Now based in Réunion Island, I combine tradition with creativity to bring you a unique and genuine Asian dining experience.
